row.team_price_text: Basic: $199/mo billed annually, flat for 2 users
row.evidence: Writesonic's pricing page lists 'SSO/SAML, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR' for Enterprise and names no SCIM or user provisioning on any plan; its docs and API indexes have no SSO or SCIM pages.
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to none (by absence, medium confidence): pricing page, enterprise page, docs index and API reference index searched, none mention SCIM. Writesonic has repositioned as an AI search visibility (GEO) platform and the June Lite plan ($16/mo) no longer exists. Plans are flat per account, billed annually: Starter $79 (1 user), Basic $199 (2 users), Growth $399 (3 users), Enterprise custom; extra users $50/user/mo. Team plan is now Basic because Starter has 1 user. SSO/SAML, RBAC and audit logs are Enterprise. The REST API covers GEO data and agent tasks, not user management. Okta and Entra catalogue pages for Writesonic return 404.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Single-user plan, so not the team plan.

plans.name: Basic
plans.price_text: $199/month, billed annually; 2 users (+$50/user/mo, up to 3 more)

plans.name: Growth
plans.price_text: $399/month, billed annually; 3 users (+$50/user/mo, up to 2 more)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SSO/SAML, RBAC and audit logs listed; no SCIM or provisioning named. scim and user_api false are by absence.

scim.notes: No SCIM or automated provisioning on the pricing page, the enterprise page, the docs index (docs.writesonic.com/llms.txt) or the API index (apidocs.writesonic.com/llms.txt). Absence, not an explicit 'no'.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs advertised for Enterprise; no API documented.

limitations.text: Team members are invited by email or invite link and managed manually (admin or member role, delete via trash icon).

user_api.notes: The public REST API (X-API-KEY) covers GEO data, reports and agent tasks; no endpoints to list, create or remove workspace users. Plan for API activation is not stated on the pricing page; the enterprise page advertises MCP, API & SDK access.

fallbacks.notes: Product and API docs are public; no SSO setup guide is published.
